seo.title: Tamara Mack — Creative Technologist
seo.description: Tamara Mack is a creative technologist — principal and distinguished software engineer and software architect — designing human-centered interfaces for systems that think, act, and create.

hero.title: Creative Technologist
hero.lede: Designing human-centered interfaces for systems that think, act, and create.
hero.availability: Available for principal and distinguished engineering roles, architecture leadership, and select creative-technology engagements.
hero.visualCaption: A tesseract motif for interfaces that reveal more than one dimension.

featuredWork.heading: Systems, space, data, and AI interactions
featuredWork.lede: Six proof-led stories: media systems, creative prototyping, human-controlled AI, spatial experiences, data visualization, and experience systems—each tied to inspectable artifacts.

principles.heading: Make intelligence understandable and action reversible
principles.lede: My interface work gives people enough context to decide, recover, and stay in control.

items.title: Show the system state
items.body: Goals, assumptions, tools, and pending actions are visible before an agent changes anything.

items.title: Design the recovery path
items.body: Errors and uncertainty become useful interface states, with a safe fallback and a clear next move.

items.title: Build the proof
items.body: I connect visual direction to production code, tests, deployment constraints, and evidence people can inspect.

cta.eyebrow: Let’s make the next interface legible
cta.heading: Creative technology, principal engineering, and software architecture
cta.lede: I’m open to conversations with hiring teams seeking principal or distinguished software engineers and architects, plus a small number of focused creative-technology partners.
